subsystems.name: Encoder
subsystems.role: compresses raw observations — pixels, sensor readings — into a compact latent state, throwing away detail that does not affect what happens next.

subsystems.name: Dynamics model
subsystems.role: predicts the next latent state given the current one and an action — the actual simulator.

subsystems.name: Decoder and renderer
subsystems.role: turns latent states back into images or observations so humans and vision-based policies can use them.

subsystems.name: Imagination rollout engine
subsystems.role: runs the dynamics model forward many steps in parallel to generate synthetic experience.

subsystems.name: Policy and planner
subsystems.role: learns or searches for actions inside the simulator rather than in the real world.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: supplies the paired observation–action–outcome data the model is fitted to.

subsystems.name: Validation harness
subsystems.role: checks that imagined futures match reality before a policy is trusted on hardware.

buildSteps.title: Collect trajectories
buildSteps.detail: Record long sequences of observations, actions taken and resulting states — from teleoperated robots, vehicle fleets, game engines and video. The action labels are the scarce part; video alone is abundant but does not say what was done.

buildSteps.title: Train the encoder
buildSteps.detail: Fit a self-supervised objective that maps each frame into a latent vector, using a reconstruction or contrastive loss so that visually different but dynamically equivalent states land close together.

buildSteps.title: Fit the dynamics model
buildSteps.detail: Train a sequence model to predict the next latent from the current latent plus the action, on long context windows, with losses on both latent prediction and decoded pixels to stop the representation collapsing.

buildSteps.title: Condition on actions
buildSteps.detail: Give the model an explicit action interface — joint torques, steering and throttle, key presses — so it can answer 'what happens if I do this' rather than only 'what happens next'.

buildSteps.title: Add reward and termination heads
buildSteps.detail: Attach predictors for task reward, success and episode end, so a policy can be optimised entirely inside the model.

buildSteps.title: Train the policy in imagination
buildSteps.detail: Roll the model forward in parallel batches, have the actor-critic learn from the imagined rewards, and regularise against the model's own uncertainty so the policy does not exploit simulation artefacts.

buildSteps.title: Validate and bound drift
buildSteps.detail: Compare imagined and real rollouts, truncate rollouts where uncertainty grows, and measure whether imagined returns predict real returns.

buildSteps.title: Transfer to hardware
buildSteps.detail: Deploy the policy, collect the failures, and feed the new real data back into training — an iterative loop, since world models improve fastest where they are wrong.

prerequisites.why: compressing high-dimensional observations into stable latents is what makes long rollouts tractable.

prerequisites.tech: Scalable sequence models with long context
prerequisites.why: transformers and state-space models provide the capacity to model dynamics over many steps.
the model can only learn consequences of actions it has seen labelled; robot action data is far scarcer than video.
photorealistic next-frame prediction gives the decoder and provides a weak signal about physical regularity.
planning inside a model means many forward passes per control step, so latency decides whether it is usable in real time.

pathway.milestone: research systems learning playable dynamics in games and driving scenes, with small policies trained purely in imagination
pathway.unlocks: evidence that latent simulators can substitute for some real interaction.

pathway.milestone: robot manipulation policies trained mostly in a learned model and fine-tuned with a small amount of real data
pathway.unlocks: cuts the cost of teaching robots new tasks from months of physical trials to hours of compute.

pathway.milestone: action-conditioned video models that stay coherent over minutes of interaction
pathway.unlocks: usable planning horizons for navigation and long-horizon assembly.

pathway.milestone: shared world models combining internet video with robot and vehicle experience, with calibrated uncertainty
pathway.unlocks: agents that can rehearse a task safely before attempting it, which is the practical route to autonomy in unstructured environments.
